text:
lina: kicking off the model-route v3 rollout now — plan is staged FF enable 'route_v3' at 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 2 hours. deploybot, can you gate by telemetry and pin the old model in eu-west if anything spikes? :rocket:

deploybot: got it. scheduling staged toggle window. will run health checks at each step. command i'll use:```/deploy toggle --flag route_v3 --steps 5%,25%,50% --interval 40m --gates telemetry,errors,latency --pin-old eu-west```

sre-oncall: quick note — please set the latency gate to 95th < 350ms and error-rate < 0.5% per cohort. if either trips, auto-drag back to previous step and notify #eng-oncall.

maria: also add a short snapshot eval for hallucination regressions on the 25% step. i can provide a 30-example prompt set. if quality delta > 3% we rollback.

alex: cache warmup: warm KV caches in canaries before each step, otherwise you'll see token spike latencies. deploybot, can you include a prewarm hook?

deploybot: prewarm hook added:```prewarm: /ops/cache-warm --services=model-route-v3 --timeout=5m``` will run before promoting each cohort.

lina: thanks. one more: pin traffic to model-route-v2 for sessions already pinned for 24h after rho cutoff. we don't want session drift during the ramp.

sre-oncall: noted. pin policy: session_affinity=24h. also enabling circuit-breaker: if region load > 85% for >5m, pause ramp and open fallback to v2.

maria: sending the eval set now to deploybot via file link. once 25% step passes, i'll run a quick human check and post QA verdict.

deploybot: all configured. starting step 1 (5%) in 2m. posting progress updates here. :white_check_mark:

lina: if anything noisy appears, we abort and roll back. otherwise i'll post release notes after 50% completes — include rolling window + feature flag config + rollback rationale.

alex: FYI i'll watch autoscale and add headroom if tokens/sec increases beyond expected. ping me if concurrent requests > 12k.

deploybot: step 1 complete. telemetry: errors 0.12%, latency p95 310ms, hallucination delta -0.2%. moving to 25% in 40m.

maria: running evals now on 25% canary. will flag if quality delta > 3%.

sre-oncall: monitoring eu-west pinned v2. no drift. CPU and GPU utilization nominal.

deploybot: step 2 complete. telemetry stable. prewarm succeeded. promoting to 50% now.

lina: great work team. keep alerts loud if anything deviates. final notes: we will keep pin v2 in eu-west until full 24h session_affinity passes, then unpin. release notes draft will go to #release-notes shortly.
